purpose: Check whether frozen fixed-idle spectral noise loses short-time concentration or cross-band energy relations. Observation only, no assumed physical combustion or new excitation recipe.
check: F2 same recording9..12s, previously inspected, not pristine or independent
filter: scipy Butterworth order4 bandpass SOS, forward causal, discard4800samples from both ends. Identical processing for source and all candidates; no output audio exported
residual: Global native least-squares cos/sin/DC subtraction at frozen13frequencies, fit each observed clip independently. This is a diagnostic fixed-modal remainder, NOT separated friction or combustion. Frequency motion and modulation can remain.
surrogates: Three full-clip random Fourier phase diagnostics preserve each source's bin magnitudes and L/R relative phase. They are not source profiles, generated engine candidates, or added media. Retain all three, not a selected seed.
features: Centered skew/excess kurtosis and crest, nonoverlap10/40ms band-energy CV, maximum-to-mean energy and cross-band Pearson correlation; report finite source and all candidate values, no universal realism thresholds
controls: Symmetric binary and sine analytic moments; scale invariance; independent math.fsum moments/energy/correlation; unchanged original WAV hashes and native sample lengths
listening_question: Existing modal_texture_v1 question remains pending; do not duplicate it
